description: Weekly risk assessment workbook: a Risks register feeding a formula-driven Risk summary matrix (likelihood x severity and per-category counts). Supply only the risk rows; numbering and all summary statistics are computed by the template.

risks.description: Risk register rows. Starts at Risks!B2 so the prefilled '#' numbering formulas in column A stay intact. Use the exact list values noted per column; the Risk summary sheet counts them with COUNTIFS.

columns.description: One of: Business, Internal, Market, Operations, Regulatory, Security, Technology.
Tracking issue key, may be empty.
One of: Acceptance, Avoidance, Control, Transference.
One of: To Do, Doing, Done, Abandoned.
Owner from the Lists sheet, e.g. 'CEO', 'CTO', 'Project team'.
